answer: A payout is split thus 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The comet schedule is applied in lagoon and river shows each instalment. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3947 identities would post 3981 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
